Open tomes drift slowly through the air between the stacks, their pages turning by themselves, glowing runes lifting off the parchment.
Hundreds of books glow softly on the shelves in shifting colors, casting a gentle jewel-toned light across the gallery.
Tall ladders roll silently along the towering shelves, guided by invisible hands, pausing at requested volumes without a sound.
A silver quill floats near the central desk, writing furiously by itself, scratching fresh annotations into an enormous leather-bound ledger.
Loose pages and unrolled scrolls drift lazily through the lamplit air, circling the columns like lazy autumn leaves in a breeze.
Chained forbidden books rattle on the lowest shelves, their dark covers pulsing with a deep crimson glow that warns intruders away.
Glowing bookmarks flutter between the shelves like fireflies, each one marking a passage of particular danger or extraordinary arcane significance.
Runes lift clean off the open pages of floating volumes, hanging suspended in golden light before slowly dissolving into the warm air.
Map-charts are pinned between shelves, their ink shifting and redrawing coastlines and constellation paths as if the world constantly changes.
Towers of teetering volumes rise from every available surface, stacked impossibly high and humming faintly with the energy stored inside them.
A glowing index-orb hovers at the hall's center, rotating slowly, projecting titles and shelf locations in bright spinning script all around it.
Candle-lit reading desks line the walls, each flame burning in a different color, illuminating open books and the hands of phantom scholars.
Drifting scrolls unroll themselves mid-air and hover at eye level, displaying star charts, alchemical diagrams, and half-translated ancient incantations.
Some books breathe softly on their shelves, their spines expanding and contracting gently, as though dreaming of the knowledge sealed inside.
Ghostly annotations appear in the margins of floating texts, written by scholars long dead, their commentary still offering warnings and corrections.
A section of shelves glows violet behind a glass barrier, the books inside too volatile to open without a protective warding spell.
Enchanted ribbons weave between the shelves, each color coding a different discipline of magic, guiding students through the vast labyrinthine collection.
Pages torn free from old volumes spiral upward toward the vaulted ceiling, assembling themselves briefly into diagrams before scattering apart again.
A brass mechanical cataloguing arm slides along a ceiling rail, pulling requested volumes from high shelves and lowering them on a chain.
Several inkwells float near the writing desks, refilling quills automatically, their ink shimmering with a faint iridescent quality that never quite dries.
Stacks of scrolls tied with glowing cord hover in organized clusters, each bundle rotating slowly to display the subject inscribed on its tag.
The oldest books on the topmost shelves glow amber with age, radiating warmth and a low resonant hum that fills the upper gallery.
Tiny floating lanterns bob gently between the stacks, shedding just enough golden light for reading while leaving the far corridors in shadow.
A locked cabinet of black iron holds books wrapped in silver chain, their covers embossed with eyes that slowly blink in the dim light.
Ethereal hands drift through the stacks, pulling volumes and replacing them without disturbing the others, cataloguing the collection throughout the endless night.
